patch.summary:
Choose Agorapulse only if your buying job matches “Social scheduling plus unified inbox and reporting — per-user Standard/Professional/Advanc” rather than Switcher Studio's shape. Choose Switcher Studio only if your buying job matches “Multi-camera live video production and multistreaming for Mac/iOS marketers — Studio Seaso” rather than Agorapulse's shape. Workflow advantage: Agorapulse leans social-media-marketing, brand-monitoring; Switcher Studio leans creator-marketing. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Agorapulse is Social scheduling plus unified inbox and reporting — per-user Standard/Professional/Advanced with Custom enterprise.; Switcher Studio is Multi-camera live video production and multistreaming for Mac/iOS marketers — Studio Seasonal from $55/mo researched; Suite higher..
- Company-size focus: Agorapulse (small-business, mid-market) vs Switcher Studio (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Agorapulse-leaning social-media-marketing, brand-monitoring vs Switcher Studio-leaning creator-marketing.
- Researched limits: Agorapulse — Per-user pricing adds up for larger teams; Switcher Studio — Apple-centric live production — not a social suite or ESP.

Limitations — Agorapulse: Per-user pricing adds up for larger teams; 10-profile cap on non-Custom plans without add-ons; Switcher Studio: Apple-centric live production — not a social suite or ESP; Non-promo Studio/Suite dollars need live confirmation.
